description: Export a cubicle.script to one self-contained Python file for backtesting.py (target backtesting), vectorbt or backtrader, with the cubicle exporter: the file carries its own Pine-exact indicators and the script's machine as the runner steps it, and its header names the script hash and the fill settings. A construct the target cannot express is refused and named (say which one, and that script_rehearse still runs the script). If the deck answers that the exporter is not installed, say so; never write an export by hand. Free.
name: script_export
